name: NGC 4816 (Webb)
blurb: NGC 4816, an elliptical galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Webb.
label: ngc4816-webb
story: NGC 4816 is one of the largest elliptical galaxies in the Coma Cluster, the nearest rich cluster of galaxies. Webb imaged it to measure the subtle graininess of its starlight, called surface brightness fluctuations, as part of a new distance ladder for cosmology.

claims.text: NGC 4816 is an elliptical galaxy targeted by JWST program 5989
The program images fields centered on 39 of the largest elliptical galaxies in the Coma Cluster
The Coma Cluster is the nearest rich cluster
Webb measures surface brightness fluctuations to build a distance ladder for cosmology
